a.lede: After a shocking downfall, Nvidia’s CEO is out of a job. WIRED’s Lauren Goode explains what that means for the world’s most critical chip company, the AI industry, and Jensen Huang himself.
a.title: Jensen Huang Is Gone. Now What?

b.lede: Under cofounder Jensen Huang, Nvidia has become the engine for the AI boom - and one of the tech industry's biggest environmental liabilities. Its sought-after chips have triggered a new wave of water- and chemical-intensive factories, drained power grids from inside massive data centers, and set the stage for a looming e-waste problem.
